name: PlainLife - Human Health Loop
subtitle: Womb to next womb, offline
shortDescription: The whole human health loop — womb to next womb — in one private, offline app. Plain-language, cited guidance plus Ask PlainLife. 100% on-device, no account.
longDescription:
PlainLife is the whole human health loop — womb to next womb — in one private, offline app.

Most health apps cover a single slice: a pregnancy app here, a parenting app there, a period tracker somewhere else. PlainLife brings the entire arc together as one continuous, intergenerational loop, because each stage shapes the next.

### Six Chapters, One Loop
• Origins — preconception health for both partners
• Birth — pregnancy week by week, warning signs, labor prep, postpartum
• Childhood — milestones, illness triage, feeding, sleep, growth
• Adolescence — puberty, cycle, and reproductive & sexual health
• Fertility — conception and planning the next generation
• Generations — how each stage echoes forward

### What You Get
• Ask PlainLife — ask anything and get answers from a bundled, cited knowledge base, fully offline.
• Plain-language guidance with tappable sources and clear "when to seek care" triage.
• Tools — kick counter, contraction timer, tracking, reminders, glossary, and full-text search.
• Doctor summary — turn what you've tracked into a clean handoff for your clinician.
• Voice input and read-aloud.

### Private By Design
PLAINLIFE PLUS (optional, one-time)
The core is free for everyone, including every safety & emergency guide. A one-time PlainLife Plus unlock adds the Generations insight, history & trends, whole-family profiles, advanced reminders, PDF doctor-summary export, guided photo triage, and deeper clinical detail. No subscription.

### Disclaimer
PlainLife provides health information and triage guidance — not a substitute for professional medical care. Always consult a qualified health professional, and in an emergency contact your local emergency services.
